reviews.text:
Lost Weight. My husband and I use this app to walk together a few times per week. I've lost 8 lbs and he has lost 9 (grrr)! It's been fantastic for our mental health too. I have always been a walker, my husband less so, but this app makes it so much easier to walk consistently with a plan to follow. It also builds you up as you go. We are walking further and faster than a month ago. It has been helpful to see how far you've walked, how fast, etc. Looking back on how far you've walked in the last month has been very rewarding. It also counts your steps all day which I like to see. Some of my friends have a Fitbit, but why spend the money and worry about all thata when this app can do it from my phone? Overall your app gets two big thumbs up from down here in Georgia!

PS Our dogs Winkie and Floyd are also big fans of the longer walks we've been doing 🙂

No projections. Unfortunately, the TikTok promoter says you can enter a goal weight and the app will tell you how far and how long it will take to get to said goal weight. Pretty misleading. Canceling after launching app and realize it doesn’t do any sort of thing like that. Thanks but no thanks.
In response to your response… well of course, it’s common sense. Yes. I understand the concept of walking may help with weight loss. Smh. I have other walking apps to track. Free apps. Thanks again.

Walk Before You Run-Lose it. I have been wanting for a while to loose weight by diet and a walking program. I saw this app and it was my answer!! I just love it!! A program was created for me by answering a few questions. I started to follow my program ( very easy to follow) and walking became not only something I have to do but fun. I get a great feeling of accomplishment when I reach my goals!!! New walking programs are added all the time so I never run of plans to complete each month. I most have completed 10 plans since I started using the app. I feel so accomplished which keeps me walking everyday.

I like the the warm up and stretches after all programmed for me as a beginner. I've shared the app with my friends and family who are now way more active then ever before.

This app will make my weight loss goal easier to obtain.

Walking is the best. Was looking for a walking app that would help me start walking more again and help me stick with it. Need to lose some weight, but don’t want to run. Found this walking app. The walking plans are easy to follow and do everyday. I like that it keeps track of how far I walked and how many times a week I’ve walked. Makes me want to keep walking according to the plan and not miss a day. I’ll update my review as I start to walk more, but so far so good.
UPDATE:
I've done a lot of walking. Especially using the walking plans that Walkster includes. I think I've used a dozen of them. Huge variety of them. I've done Calorie Killer 2 or 3 times. These plan have help be lose the weight I want and keep it off! They recently updated the app and it looks better than it did before. Much easier to use than the previous version. The other great thing about this app is their support and instructions.

Waste of money. This is the biggest waste of money. They advertise giving you a walking goal to meet your goals on a timeline. They give you a walking goal but doesn’t project weight loss as they advertised. An overpriced pedometer.

reviews.text:
Great app for me. This app has been really helpful for me to get out and walk a few times a week. The biggest thing it has helped me with is weight loss. I have always struggled to lose weight around my hips especially. I tend towards a pretty sedentary lifestyle. I do love getting out in nature, I just find it difficult to motivate. Walkster has helped me get out more consistently and stay on track with walking plans that I actually stick to. I am definitely noticing a difference. I dropped all pant size which is fantastic (even though it’s a bit annoying that my pants don’t fit as well! Worth it!). 

It’s also been really great for my mental health to get outdoors a few times per week. I already notice a difference in my endurance, and I feel a mood uplift as well. Like a brain fog has lifted. The warm ups, exercises and videos are very helpful. The app is easy to use and gives me lots of useful information and walk history. All in all I rate this app 5 stars.
You don’t find out how much to walk to lose weight.. Literally why I got the app and paid and that third screen that says “see your plan “ and tells you how long/see your plan doesn’t exist. Boo.
